open.thesis: Team 13 roster Josh Allen and Lamar Jackson in a one-QB league and start Travis Kelce in their RB/WR/TE flex because no third receiver clears him. Golden fixes their flex; the quarterback they give up never plays.
open.falsifiedIf: They trade or drop one quarterback, acquire a third receiver, or Golden's price rises past what the flex gap is worth to them.
open.review: Re-verified 14 Sep 13:10Z against a fresh snapshot, HELD and still live — nobody has accepted or declined. Slot column re-checked rather than trusted: Josh Allen slot 0 starting, Lamar Jackson slot 20 benched, Travis Kelce slot 23 in their RB/WR/TE flex. Recomputed on season projections: +26.5 me / +12.2 them. New finding added to the card as a fallback ask — team 13 also carry two defences, Seattle starting at slot 16 and Houston benched at slot 20, and Golden for the Texans defence also clears both sides (+28.7 me / +6.1 them). Review after week 4.

open.thesis: Lawrence is the starting quarterback from week 2, benching Stafford. Confirmed by week 1 rather than assumed: 18 of 23, 245 yards, four touchdowns in three quarters against Stafford's 4.1. ESPN has Lawrence QB9 and Stafford unranked, so projection and reporting agree for once.
open.falsifiedIf: Stafford clearly out-scores Lawrence in two consecutive weeks, or the Jackson trade lands, which makes Lawrence the trade chip rather than the starter.
open.review: Reviewed 14 Sep, HELD. Nothing has happened since the week 1 result that settled it (Lawrence 25.6 in three quarters, Stafford 4.1) and the swap has not yet been executed because rosters have not rolled. Added to the card: Jacksonville draw Denver in week 2, which is a hard first assignment for the thesis and takes Tuten, Cam Little and the defence with it.

open.thesis: Drop Mayer the moment rosters unlock. His thesis closed WRONG when Bowers's return timeline emerged; this is the card that acts on it. Amended 14 Sep, certainty reduced: the reporting is that Bowers had a meniscus trim in Dallas after a camp injury went undiagnosed until the week before the opener, and Rapoport and Schefter both put him at 'a game or two' — NOT a confirmed week 2 return, which is how yesterday's version phrased it. The roster maths carries the drop regardless of which week he returns: 85.0 season projection on a 9.3 weekly is a ratio of 9.1 against a league median of 17.0 and the lowest total on the roster. No replacement named on purpose: every usable tight end is on waivers and this league's priority never resets.
open.falsifiedIf: Bowers suffers a setback and misses week 2 as well, which restores the role and makes the drop premature. No week 2 practice report exists yet — practices begin Wednesday. Check Wednesday's first report and Friday's designation before executing.
open.review: Reviewed 14 Sep 13:30Z, UNRESOLVED. The falsification condition is live, not beaten: 'a game or two' spans both a week 2 and a week 3 return and there is no practice data yet. Card kept with the certainty corrected down and an explicit check added.

closed.summary: The kicker slot went Little -> Boswell on 8 Sep and Boswell -> Little on 10 Sep. The same slot reversed in two days for no stated reason.
Allgeier added 8 Sep, dropped 10 Sep. Two days on the roster, no stated thesis either way.

The Tuten-for-Lamar proposal is withdrawn in favour of the Golden-for-Allen version. Season projections later confirmed its own stated risk: Tuten 205.2 against Lloyd 135.6, so the swap the weekly model called free was seventy points of season value.

Michael Mayer thesis FALSIFIED, exactly as its condition predicted and three weeks early. Schefter reports Bowers returns at the Chargers in week 2, which ends the role the add was made for. Mayer scored 9.2 and projects 85.0 for the season, the lowest on the roster. He is the drop the moment the week rolls and players unlock. The thesis was sound when written and the falsification condition did its job — this is the log working, not a mistake.

Trevor Lawrence hold resolved RIGHT and decisively. Lawrence 18 of 23 for 245 and four touchdowns, a 150.6 rating and 25.6 fantasy points in three quarters of a 34-10 win; Stafford returned 4.1 the same week. The thesis said Lawrence starts from week 2 and that is now a published card. Closing this and opening the lineup thesis in its place.
